title: Model Compare
description: Run two Cellpose configurations on the same fields and compare parameters, object counts, foreground ARI, matching, splits, merges, and mask previews.
objectives: Load a small shared field set and configure two model candidates.
Confirm which requested parameters actually reach Cellpose 4.
Interpret directional object differences, foreground ARI, matching, QC, and overlays.
prerequisite: Prepare representative microscopy fields and at least two meaningfully different models or inference configurations.

scenes.narration: Model Compare runs two Cellpose configurations on the same small field set. It reports what changed without treating either model as ground truth, combining object counts, foreground agreement, matching, fragmentation, and visual overlays.
scenes.speech_text: Model Compare runs two Cellpose configurations on the same small field set. It reports what changed without treating either model as ground truth, combining object counts, foreground agreement, matching, fragmentation, and visual overlays.

scenes.narration: Drop a folder of TIFF, PNG, NPY, or NPZ fields, or choose it with the source controls. The Fields value limits an interactive comparison; this tutorial loads three real ER-channel cell crops.
scenes.speech_text: Drop a folder of Tiff, P N G, N P Y, or N P Z fields, or choose it with the source controls. The Fields value limits an interactive comparison; this tutorial loads three real E R channel cell crops.

scenes.narration: Model A uses stock CPSAM. Model B uses the custom calibration checkpoint from Train Cellpose. Both retain diameter thirty, flow threshold zero point four, probability zero, minimum size fifteen, normalization, and full-resolution dynamics.
scenes.speech_text: Model A uses stock C P Sam. Model B uses the custom calibration checkpoint from Train Cellpose. Both retain diameter thirty, flow threshold zero point four, probability zero, minimum size fifteen, normalization, and full resolution dynamics.

scenes.narration: Compare segments every loaded field with both configurations. The extra line accepts advanced key-value arguments, and the report marks parameters Cellpose 4 ignores rather than silently implying they changed the model.
scenes.speech_text: Compare segments every loaded field with both configurations. The extra line accepts advanced key value arguments, and the report marks parameters Cellpose four ignores rather than silently implying they changed the model.

scenes.narration: During processing, the inline status identifies both candidates and the number of fields. Model Compare stays focused on a bounded interactive sample rather than running a full plate twice.
scenes.speech_text: During processing, the inline status identifies both candidates and the number of fields. Model Compare stays focused on a bounded interactive sample rather than running a full plate twice.

scenes.narration: Parameters that reached each model separates honored values from deprecated or ignored arguments. This prevents comparisons that look different in the form but resolve to the same Cellpose behavior.
scenes.speech_text: Parameters that reached each model separates honored values from deprecated or ignored arguments. This prevents comparisons that look different in the form but resolve to the same Cellpose behavior.

scenes.narration: The per-field table reports object counts, directional delta, background-excluded adjusted Rand index, matched fraction, mean intersection over union, splits, merges, unmatched objects, and independent mask-quality checks.
scenes.speech_text: The per field table reports object counts, directional delta, background excluded adjusted Rand index, matched fraction, mean intersection over union, splits, merges, unmatched objects, and independent mask quality checks.

scenes.narration: Selecting a row updates both previews. Matched objects are shown consistently, while unmatched regions expose new detections, misses, splits, or merges that a single aggregate score can hide.
scenes.speech_text: Selecting a row updates both previews. Matched objects are shown consistently, while unmatched regions expose new detections, misses, splits, or merges that a single aggregate score can hide.

scenes.narration: Across these three fields, both candidates produced one hundred fifty-one objects, foreground ARI one, and one hundred percent matching. That means the one-epoch calibration checkpoint behaves like its starting model here; it is a valid result, not evidence of improvement.
